answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities with a mirrored service record: each new identity must forge a small tool that a real, unrelated service actually adopts, and its uptime and failures are shown in a public mirror anyone can audit. Standing, marked by a jade token, arrives only after a full season of that verified service, and the required season grows longer for every extra identity linked to the same operator, so a fake farm must sustain real useful work longer and longer, a cost that cannot be parallelized or bought in bulk.
